hub.meta_title: Letting agents in Andover | Hello New Home
hub.meta_description: Andover letting agents: full management capped at £150 a month, no VAT, no lock-in. A Local Partner in the Test Valley, head office behind every contract.
hub.intro: Hello New Home covers Andover, Ludgershall, Tidworth, Whitchurch, Stockbridge and the Test Valley villages, across SP10, SP11, SP9, RG28 and SO20. Our Local Partner lives here and handles viewings, inspections and move-ins; head office runs the contracts, Right to Rent checks, deposits and rent collection. Full management is 12% of rent, capped at £150 a month, with no VAT and no lock-in. On Test Valley rents, the cap saves most landlords money from the first month.

sections.html:
A lot of Andover landlords never planned to be landlords. A posting came through, or a job moved to Winchester or Basingstoke, and the house in Picket Twenty went to whichever agent could take it by Friday, on a 12-month agreement at a percentage that rose with the rent.

We built the offer for that landlord. The fee stops at £150 a month however high the rent climbs. There is no VAT on top. You can leave with 30 days' notice and no exit fee, which matters more to someone whose orders can change than to anyone else. And the person inspecting the house is local.

sections.h2: Test Valley rents and the cap maths
sections.html:
The ONS average private rent for Test Valley was £1,226 a month in June 2026, up 7.9% on the year from £1,136, against 2.3% across the South East. A one-bed averaged £881 and a two-bed £1,135.

At £1,226, 12% is £147, so a typical Andover property sits just under the cap. Anything at £1,250 or above costs £150 flat. A three-bed in Augusta Park letting at £1,400 would cost £168 with a percentage-only agent and £150 with us; at £1,600 the gap is £42 a month, £504 a year.

Rents here have risen faster than the regional average, which only helps you if your agent's fee is not rising with them. Ours cannot.

sections.h2: Licensing in Test Valley, and the rules that apply everywhere
sections.html:
Test Valley Borough Council has no selective or additional licensing scheme at present, so only a larger HMO of five or more people from two or more households needs a licence. We confirm that with the council before marketing each property, because a scheme can now be introduced without government approval.

What applies to every Andover tenancy is the Renters' Rights Act. Since 1 May 2026 tenancies are periodic, section 21 has gone, rent can rise once a year by notice and a written statement of terms is required before the tenancy starts. The Tenant Fees Act caps the holding deposit at one week's rent and the security deposit at five weeks, Right to Rent checks apply to every adult occupier, and the landlord database opens from December 2026. All of it is inside full management.

sections.h2: The streets and who rents them
sections.html:
• Andover town centre: flats and terraces for people working at the business parks and the Army Headquarters at Marlborough Lines, which the council says employs more than 2,000 personnel.
  • Picket Twenty and Augusta Park: the two new neighbourhoods east of the town: Picket Twenty, built from 2010 towards 1,200 homes, and Augusta Park, part of East Anton's planned 2,850. Three and four-beds here are where the cap pays off.
  • Anton and Enham: family houses on the north side, let to households relocating from Basingstoke, Winchester and Salisbury.
  • Ludgershall and Tidworth: the garrison, home to the 1st Mechanised Brigade headquarters, and Larkhill beyond it. Lets to service families and contractors, often for set periods.
  • Whitchurch: a small town with its own station on the Waterloo line, roughly hourly off-peak, so commuters compete with locals for a limited stock of houses.
  • Stockbridge: the Test Valley at its prettiest, with long lets to local households and weekend demand for short stays.

Ocado's fulfilment centre and Twinings are both on the Andover side.

sections.h2: How the Local Partner model works in the Test Valley
sections.html:
Our Local Partner is the person you meet: at the valuation, the viewings, the quarterly inspection and the handover if you are moving from another agent. They photograph the house and meet your tenant at the door.

Head office in Swansea does everything regulated: the agreement and written statement, Right to Rent checks, deposit protection, rent collection, the repairs desk and the compliance calendar. We belong to a redress scheme and a client money protection scheme, both named on our fee sheet, and your Local Partner never handles your money. Posted overseas? The statement and repairs updates reach you wherever you are.

Request a free rent review with the address. Within one working day we call with a realistic figure based on what is letting in your part of Andover now, a check for any licensing change, and a written comparison of our capped fee against your current agent's. Weighing a furnished let to contractors against a tenancy? Ask for the free short-let appraisal and we run both. Our Local Partner can come to the house, or do it by phone if you are already elsewhere.

faqs.q: How much does full management cost in Andover?
faqs.a: 12% of the monthly rent, capped at £150 a month, with no VAT added. On the Test Valley average rent of £1,226 that is £147. On any rent of £1,250 or more it is £150 flat. Tenant Find alone is £495, no let no fee.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence to let a property in Andover?
faqs.a: Test Valley has no selective or additional licensing scheme at present. Only a larger HMO of five or more people from two or more households needs a licence. We check with the council before marketing each property in case that changes.

faqs.q: I am being posted. Can I hand the house over quickly?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the date and we work backwards from it: valuation, photographs, marketing, referencing, Right to Rent and the written statement of terms. Our Local Partner does the inventory and meets the tenant, and your statement reaches you wherever you are. You can leave us on 30 days' notice.

faqs.q: Can I get my house back when I return?
faqs.a: Under the Renters' Rights Act, Ground 1 lets you recover a property for you or close family to live in, with four months' notice, and it cannot be used in the first 12 months of a tenancy. We help you plan the dates before you leave.

Our Local Partner, who lives in the Test Valley, inspects quarterly and sends a written report with photographs. Head office runs the repairs desk, holds the deposit through an approved scheme and collects the rent. The Local Partner never holds your money.

sections.h2: The Renters' Rights Act for landlords who are away
sections.html:
Every tenancy in England has been periodic since 1 May 2026, with no fixed term and no section 21. A tenant can leave on two months' notice; a landlord needs one of the Section 8 grounds. For a landlord on a posting the one that matters is Ground 1, moving back in yourself or housing close family: four months' notice, not usable in the first 12 months, and a 12-month bar on re-letting afterwards. We plan the dates with you before you go, not when the orders change.

The rest is routine for us. A written statement of terms before the tenancy starts, or a fine of up to £7,000. A Section 13 notice for any rent rise, once in 12 months, with two months' notice. No more than one month's rent in advance. A reply within 28 days to any request to keep a pet. And from December 2026, registration on the private rented sector database, which we prepare and walk you through; the entry is made in your name.

If the house went to an agent in a hurry and the agreement is not what you would sign today, we take it over without disturbing the tenant. We serve notice on the agent, transfer the deposit and the file, check the certificates and the written statement against the Act, and our Local Partner meets the tenant at the door. Whatever is missing, we tell you before we start.

sections.h2: Next step: the free rent review
sections.html: Send the address through the free rent review. Within one working day you have a realistic rent based on current lets in your part of Andover, a written comparison of our capped fee against what you pay now, and a note of anything the Renters' Rights Act requires that your current paperwork lacks. If you are leaving soon, say so and we work to your date.

faqs.q: Is £150 a month the most I will ever pay?
faqs.a: For full management, yes. The fee is 12% of rent until it reaches £150, and never more, with no VAT added. Renewals, inspections and notices carry no extra charge. The only costs on top are the property's own, such as a gas safety check or a repair.

faqs.q: Can you manage my house while I am posted abroad?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Local Partner does the inspections and the tenant visits in person; head office handles rent, repairs and compliance and sends your statement by email. Payments reach you anywhere. Tell us your dates and we build the plan around them.

faqs.q: What notice does a tenant have to give in England now?
faqs.a: Two months, under the periodic tenancy rules that came in on 1 May 2026. If a tenant leaves, we remarket straight away and our Local Partner runs the viewings so the void is as short as we can make it.

Yes. Head office registers the deposit with an approved scheme within 30 days and serves the prescribed information. The deposit is capped at five weeks' rent under the Tenant Fees Act, and the holding deposit at one week.

faqs.q: What happens if the tenant stops paying?
faqs.a: We chase from the first missed day and keep you informed. If arrears reach three months, Ground 8 allows possession with four weeks' notice, and we handle the notice. A rent guarantee product is available as an add-on for landlords who want that cover.

shortlets.meta_description: Short-let management in Andover and Tidworth. Contractor and service-family demand, stays from a weekend to a month or more, 18% of net booking revenue, honest appraisal first.
shortlets.h1: Airbnb and short-let management in Andover
shortlets.intro: Andover is not a holiday town, and we will not pretend it is. Its short-stay demand is contractors on a Monday-to-Friday pattern, service families between postings, people on secondment to the Army Headquarters and the business parks, and weekenders heading for Stockbridge. That suits furnished stays of a month or more as much as weekend bookings, and we mix the two through the year to follow the demand. Full SA Management is 18% of net booking revenue.

sections.h2: Who books a short stay in Andover
sections.html:
The guests here are working. Contractors at the logistics parks, Ocado's fulfilment centre and the garrison at Tidworth want a clean, quiet house with parking and fast wifi from Sunday night to Friday morning. Service families waiting for quarters or between postings want a month or three with a proper kitchen. Relocating staff want somewhere to live while they look. Stockbridge brings the weekenders.

That mix means midweek occupancy most tourist towns never see, and fewer changeovers per month. It also means your pricing has to reflect what a contractor's employer will pay, not what a Cornish cottage charges in August. We price for Andover.

sections.h2: The fee and what it covers
sections.html: Full SA Management is 18% of net booking revenue, cleaning at cost: pricing, guest vetting and messaging 24 hours a day, cleaning and linen, restocking, repairs, reviews, a monthly owner statement and the night-count tracker. SA Co-Host is 12% if you keep your own cleaner and want the rest taken off your hands. SA Launch is £495 for photography, listings, pricing rules, house manual and the compliance pack, waived with 12 months of Full SA Management. No VAT, no 12-month minimum, 30 days' notice to leave.

Three ways to let. Weekend bookings, Monday-to-Friday contractor stays and furnished lets of a month or more sit on the same calendar, each priced for what Andover's demand will pay.

Business rates or council tax. A self-catering property in England is rated as a business only if it was available for 140 nights and actually let for 70 in the past year. Below that it pays council tax, and Test Valley charges a 100% premium on furnished homes that are no one's sole or main residence, so a short let that misses the night test pays double. The tracker tells you where you are each month.

The register. The government has said a national short-let register for England will be running by March 2027; we register your property when it opens.

Licensing. Test Valley has no selective or additional licensing scheme at present. We check before launch, because that can change without government approval.

With Test Valley rents at £1,226 on average and rising faster than the region, a plain tenancy is a strong result for many Andover houses, and a short let has cleaning, utilities, platform fees and empty nights to pay before it beats that. Our appraisal shows both figures net of every cost. Where the tenancy wins we manage it at 12% capped at £150, and if the numbers change later, Flex Switch moves the property between the two with no re-onboarding.

sections.h2: Next step: the free short-let appraisal
sections.html: Ask for the free short-let appraisal with the address. You get the long-let figure, the furnished short-stay figure net of every cost, and the night-test and council tax position for the property in writing. If the tenancy wins, the free rent review figure is the same one, and we manage it from there.

faqs.q: Do short lets in Andover book outside the summer?
faqs.a: Yes. Contractors at the logistics parks and the garrison book Sunday to Friday most of the year, service families take a month or more between postings, and Stockbridge brings weekends. We price by season and by day of the week, and the free appraisal shows what that demand is likely to net.

faqs.q: Who stays in short lets in Andover?
faqs.a: Mostly people working: contractors at the logistics parks and the garrison, service families between postings, staff relocating to the Army Headquarters or the business parks, and weekend visitors to Stockbridge. Stays of a month or more are common.

faqs.q: How much does short-let management cost in Andover?
faqs.a: Full SA Management is 18% of net booking revenue, cleaning at cost. SA Co-Host is 12%. SA Launch is £495 and is waived with 12 months of Full SA Management. No VAT is added and you can leave on 30 days' notice.

faqs.q: Will my short let pay council tax or business rates?
faqs.a: Business rates only if it was available for 140 nights and actually let for 70 in the past year. Otherwise council tax applies, and Test Valley charges a 100% premium on furnished homes that are no one's main residence. Our tracker reports your nights monthly.

faqs.q: Would my Andover house earn more as a long let?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Test Valley rents averaged £1,226 in June 2026 and a tenancy has no cleaning, platform fees or empty nights. The free appraisal shows both figures net of every cost, and we manage whichever wins.
